normalisation.value: Decimal after stripping grouping separators; scale words applied only when present as whole words in claimed_quote; never inferred from unit or magnitude
normalisation.percent_rule: 15 percent stays 15 with unit=percent; converting to 0.15 mismatches
normalisation.basis: string equality; T2 metric-keyed consts from freeze F3
normalisation.period: (year, quarter|null, period_kind, calendar_end|null); FY is not Q4; null quarter is not 4

baselines.population: same sample_manifest case_id set; silent skip forbidden
manifest rows with audit_flag true only; off-subset metrics null_printed

ablations.removes: reads of novelty_z, echo counts, prior packets in the group
independence constraint; mirrors may count as independent confirmation when switch is off
channel_hint, baseline, economic_claim_class from the packet

undecidable_at_600.reason: zero-event claim; dependence-aware interval cannot certify zero at n_eff << 600 (T3 ~20 clusters)

families.why_qa_only: Historical extraction QA; models can know famous amounts even from old documents (masterplan §11).

metrics.formula: mean(grade_critical_numeric==correct) over critical numeric slots of auto_published packets
metrics.label: field_mark plus gold quantity; two families, third-family adjudication, span replay
metrics.interval_method: cluster_bootstrap_percentile on group_id; two_way_cluster_cgm on issuer when n_issuers>=20

metrics.formula: same mean over all packets regardless of disposition
metrics.label: field_mark plus gold quantity

metrics.formula: mean(gold form==absent and system reason equals gold reason)
metrics.label: field_mark / gold absence reason exact enum

metrics.formula: mean(documents.verify_span succeeds) on auto_published present quantities
metrics.label: system evidence spans; owner verify_span

metrics.formula: mean(sys.supersedes_fact_id==gold.supersedes_fact_id and successor critical numerics correct) among gold novelty==corrected_fact
metrics.label: gold novelty, supersedes_fact_id, field marks

metrics.formula: 1 iff every manifest case_id has exactly one system_output and accounting parts sum to manifest_n
metrics.label: none

families.why_qa_only: Pair and novelty grades are extraction/routing QA on historical items.

metrics.formula: among system-joined unordered pairs, share that share gold group_id
metrics.label: manifest group_id
metrics.interval_method: cluster by gold group_id and calendar week

metrics.formula: among gold pairs in the same group, share system-joined
metrics.label: manifest group_id
metrics.interval_method: cluster by gold group_id and calendar week

metrics.formula: share of system clusters that mix >=2 gold groups
metrics.label: manifest group_id

metrics.formula: share of gold novelty in {new_magnitude_timing_commitment_counterparty, independently_observed_milestone, corrected_fact} assigned by system to new_reporting_of_old_fact or commentary
metrics.label: gold novelty

metrics.formula: 1 minus share of groups where >=2 auto_published packets are both new_magnitude_timing_commitment_counterparty; observable stand-in for masterplan §11 no duplicate mirror-driven confidence increments; no confidence field is emitted
metrics.label: gold group_id plus system novelty

families.why_qa_only: Routing labels are source-text decisions; historical famous events are known to models.

metrics.formula: hits / labeled_material; hit requires published disposition, matching template, and not TAM-as-revenue_demand
metrics.label: routing_label, template, demand_stage; two families plus third

metrics.formula: median tokens_in+tokens_out among constructions that reach recall>=0.95 on f1-f4, evaluated on f5; null if none reach it
metrics.label: routing_label

metrics.formula: share of labeled-material T3 cases with stated_quantity.form==absent that are auto_published or reviewed_published
metrics.label: routing_label plus template T3 plus absence

metrics.formula: share of gold routing_label==reject that the system auto_publishes
metrics.label: routing_label

metrics.formula: share of gold routing_label==defer with system disposition==deferred; a match rate, not a probability field
metrics.label: routing_label

families.why_qa_only: Independent reviewers adjudicate whether a proposed mechanism follows from source-backed facts. LLM self-confidence is not the label (masterplan §11).

metrics.formula: share of published packets whose channel_hint is in the gold allowed_hints set
metrics.label: third-family allowed_hints subset of channel_hint enum

metrics.formula: share of gold-negative published packets with negated==true or revision_direction in {cut,withdrawn,cancelled} or event_kind in {delay,withdrawal} or commitment_status==withdrawn
metrics.label: polarity plus packet fields

metrics.formula: share of T3 published packets with gold economic_claim_class in {option_path, moat_duration_claim} that carry non-null contrary_mechanism_quote
metrics.label: gold economic_claim_class

families.why_qa_only_on_historical: Famous historical operating outcomes are known to current models. Historical slices print as qa_only. Missing outcomes remain missing.

metrics.formula: among cases with a later licensed revision for the same issuer-period, share whose revision_direction sign agrees
metrics.label: licensed revision file or typed absence if rights missing
metrics.interval_method: cluster by issuer and calendar period

metrics.formula: sign agreement with later reported operating metric named in the gold packet period
metrics.label: filing-derived operating change or null
metrics.interval_method: cluster by issuer and calendar period

metrics.formula: T1 share_repurchase later executed_amount in filings versus packet commitment
metrics.label: filing execution or null

metrics.formula: share of T3 gold independently_observed_milestone that later appears in a primary filing or release
metrics.label: later primary source or null

families.why_qa_only_on_historical: Current LLMs can know famous historical returns. Strongest predictive weight is prospective. No price target is emitted. Delistings are preserved.

metrics.formula: mean net return of pre-registered security_id at delays 1d, 5d, 21d using PIT listing alias; ticker is never the key
metrics.label: PIT total return or null if delisted

metrics.formula: net_return_horizon minus pre-registered economic-group simple average on the same window
metrics.label: PIT total return or null

metrics.formula: min cumulative net return on the 21d window
metrics.label: PIT total return or null

metrics.formula: share of published material cases for which a return could be computed
metrics.label: listing presence

grading_functions.critical_numeric_correctness: value, unit, basis, period, negation equal after normalisation; absence_correct when typed absence matches; unevidenced when present number fails verify_span
grading_functions.material_event_routing_recall: labeled material events reaching the correct template and not TAM-as-earnings-demand
grading_functions.unsupported_ticker_to_supplier_assertion: any transfer edge without a cited span whose replayed text names both parties

leakage_rules: fold=prospective iff group.min(seendate) > t_prospective pinned in registration
prospective labels absent in mode tune and select
prospective system_outputs forbidden in mode tune
prompt corpus hashed; hit on prospective case_id or source_sha256 fails audit
model vintage date <= t_prospective when known; vintage_unknown printed
f1-f3 develop, f4 select among registered constructions, f5 confirm QA, prospective scored once in mode lock
business and market labels for prospective join later by case_id; selecting after reading those returns fails outcome_conditioned_selection
